description: The legal gross hourly minimum wage for household work (cleaning, childcare, care) at a Swiss workplace: federal NAV tiers by qualification, cantonal minimum wages (GE, NE, JU, TI, BS), city minimum wages (Stadt Luzern in force; Stadt Zürich in force from 1.1.2027 with a transition period for employers until 31.12.2027; Winterthur voted, no date yet) and the rule below 5 hours a week. Give the workplace postcode for the exact answer, or a canton.

canton.description: Canton, if no postcode is known. A postcode is better: some cities have their own minimum wage.

hours_per_week.description: Weekly hours with this household. The federal NAV floor binds from 5 hours a week; below that only some cantonal or city minimums apply.

language.description: Language of the explanatory texts and of the clino.ch links: en, de, fr, it, es or pt. Default en.

postcode.description: 4-digit Swiss postcode (PLZ/NPA) of the WORKPLACE. City minimum wages (e.g. Stadt Luzern) depend on it.

skill_level.description: Qualification of the worker, which sets the federal NAV wage tier: unskilled; experienced (4+ years in household work); eba (2-year federal vocational certificate); efz (3-year federal vocational diploma).

name: get_minimum_wage

binding_floor_chf_per_hour.description: The gross hourly minimum that binds for the given hours (from 5 h/week if no hours were given). null = no statutory floor binds at these hours.

city_minimum_uncertain.description: true when the canton has a city minimum but the workplace postcode was not given or straddles a boundary: the floor may be higher.

employers_comply_by.description: ISO date, last day of the transition period the city gave employers to apply the minimum wage. Until it has passed the amount is not owed.

in_force_from.description: ISO date from which the city's ordinance is in force, or null while the city has published no date. In force is not yet owed: see employers_comply_by.

city_minimum_voted_not_in_force.description: A city minimum wage that is voted but does not bind yet (the field name is kept for compatibility). Stadt Zürich: in force from 2027-01-01, employers have until 2027-12-31 to apply it.

data_verified_on.description: Date the rate set was last checked against the official sources.

for_workers.description: Clino's free guide for domestic workers: rights, pay by canton, a wage check and free training.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence of the source that states the value.

title: Minimum wage for household work
